newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Rail offers tumble on demand.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Rail offers tumble on demand.

text.p: Some rail soymeal offers fell further Friday as high prices continued to keep most end-users out of the market, soymeal brokers said.
"All the meal buyers want something big today to happen on the downside (of the market)," said one Indiana-based truck dealer. "They're hurting pretty bad right now."
The market was also captivated by widespread talk that China has canceled up to 450,000 tonnes of soymeal purchases from South America and India, dealers said.
If a cancellation of that magnitude did occur, it would likely pressure the crushing pace for next week, sources said.
No confirmation of the cancellation could be obtained.
The National Oilseed Processors Association on Thursday reported the weekly crush was 30.864 million bushels. That figure was well above trade estimates for 29.00 million to 30.30 million bushels.
